'''Hakaba Net''' was a communication company that went bankrupt, which led to widespread looting of their abandoned [[Comm station/Legends|comm stations]] in the [[Planetary ring/Legends|meteor rings]] orbiting [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].
